entities.summary: Nikita Andreyevich Krylov is a Ukrainian-born Russian professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Light Heavyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). A professional since 2012, Krylov has also competed for M-1 Global. As of August 26, 2025, he is #13 in the UFC light heavyweight rankings.
